content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Gangtok Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 22-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Gangtok Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ECHS Gangtok recruitment is 22nd October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Medical Officer and Dental Hygienist/Assistant/Technician posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 post for Medical Officer and 1 post for Dental Hygienist/Assistant/Technician.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Medical Officer post, candidates must have an MBBS degree with a minimum of 3 years of experience after internship. Additional qualifications in Medicine or Surgery are preferable.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications for the Dental Hygienist/Assistant/Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma in Dental Hygienist/Class-I DH/DORA Course with at least 5 years of experience, or 10+2 with Science and a 2-year Diploma in Dental Hygienist/Dental Mechanic with at least 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS Gangtok Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 36,500 to Rs. 95,000 per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview date for the ECHS Gangtok Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The interview date is scheduled for 27th October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, which is www.echs.gov.in.
